name: Florida DEP Public Notice of Pollution (PNP) ArcGIS feature service
waters_covered: statewide; waterbody only as Y/N in the template text, named in free text sometimes
access_detail: https://ags.dep.state.fl.us/arcgis/rest/services/External_Services/PNP/FeatureServer/0 "Public Notice of Pollution (Last 30 Days)" (208 rows on 2026-11-03) and https://ags.dep.state.fl.us/arcgis/rest/services/External_Services/PNP/FeatureServer/1 "(All)" (16,571 rows). Query /query?where=...&outFields=...&f=json; maxRecordCount 10000. Also MapServer at the same path; mirror host ca.dep.state.fl.us. HTML list http://prodenv.dep.state.fl.us/DepPNP/reports/viewIncidentDetails?page=1.

sample_record.INCIDENT_REPORT: Incident Description: Manhole in the middle of 17th St ... is overflowing due to extreme weather. Wastewater Type: Untreated Cause: Extreme Weather Spill Volume:  Volume Recovered: 0 Waterbodies Impacted: Y Clean-up Status: Planned Clean-up Actions: Other Agencies Notified: [redacted]

fills_event_fields: source_record_id (INCIDENT_NUMBER = State Watch Office number, often null on older rows)
cannot_fill: waterbody (only Y/N; name sometimes in text)
cadence: Continuous; notices appear within hours of submission (newest 2026-11-03 05:00 UTC on 2026-11-03). Median 36 hours from release start (date only) to report. Law: operator within 24 hours of discovery; DEP publishes within 24 hours of receipt.
history: July 2017 to date (layer 1); before that a mailing-list archive for Jan to June 2017 at lists.dep.state.fl.us/pipermail/pollution.notice/. About 1,300 to 2,300 notices a year (2018: 1,332; 2024: 2,279; 2025: 1,585).
license: No terms on the PNP page; floridadep.gov carries a site disclaimer only.
status_reason: Statewide, machine-readable, event-precision notices under s. 403.077 with report time, release start/end, ongoing flag, facility, county and coordinates; wastewater notices use a structured text template (Wastewater Type, Cause, Spill Volume, Waterbodies Impacted). First feed to build.
notes: PRIVACY: REPORTER_*/CONTACT_* fields and the "Agencies Notified" text hold personal names, emails and phones. Never request those fields; strip "Agencies Notified" and run the name blocklist over INCIDENT_REPORT. The layer mixes all pollution (fuel, stormwater, citizen complaints); filter on the wastewater template text and facility type. In the last 30 days 81 of 200 notices were "Wastewater Type: Untreated". RELEASE_START_DATE_TIME is a date at 00:00 UTC (no time).

name: Florida DEP PNP email subscription by county
status_reason: Statutory email list (403.077(3)(b)) by county or district. The ArcGIS layer is the same data; subscribe only as a cross-check.

name: Florida DEP Wastewater Historical Spills (ArcGIS, frozen 2020)
status_reason: 13,988 State Watch Office wastewater incidents with structured cause, volume, waterbody affected and points; last edited 2020-10-07. Useful history; holds CALLER_NAME (personal) so must be field-filtered.

name: Fla. Stat. 403.077 Public notification of pollution
status_reason: The public-notice law: operator notice to DEP within 24 hours; DEP publishes within 24 hours and runs a county email list.
notes: (2)(a) owner or operator must "provide to the department information reported to the State Watch Office ... within 24 hours after the owner's or operator's discovery of such reportable pollution release"; (3)(a) the department publishes notices on a public website "within 24 hours after receipt"; (3)(b) email list by county or district.

name: F.A.C. 62-604.550 Abnormal events (collection systems) and 62-620.610(20)
status_reason: Regulator reporting: SSOs of 1,000 gallons or more to the State Watch Office (800-320-0519) within 24 hours; smaller ones to the DEP district within 24 hours. Rule text (a .doc) not read; wording from DEP 2021 SSO guidance.

name: Florida Department of Health Healthy Beaches program (beach detail pages; sampling-point layer)
access_detail: https://services1.arcgis.com/CY1LXxl9zlJeBuRZ/arcgis/rest/services/FloridaBeachSamplingPoints/FeatureServer/0 (419 points; fields County, EPAbeachID, STORET_Sta, SPLocation, Active, SPLat, SPLong, Link). Beach-detail HTML is a WordPress shell; data comes through admin-ajax (not traced).
status_reason: Weekly enterococci sampling at 419 points (layer FloridaBeachSamplingPoints with EPA beach ids and links). The result and advisory status load by script on each beach-detail page; no public endpoint found yet. County DOH offices issue sewage-spill health advisories separately (search only).

name: Florida DEP Algal Bloom Site Visits (Algal Bloom Sampling Status dashboard)
status_reason: 6,778 sampling visits with date, coordinates, bloom observed, dominant taxa, microcystin; edited daily. HAB source (plum).

name: EPA SOBE extract, FL rows
status_reason: No FL rows on 2026-11-03; FL reports through the State Watch Office and PNP.

name: Sarasota County AbnormalEventSpill layer
status_reason: County spill layer found by ArcGIS search; not opened. The PNP feed covers the same events.

name: JEA Environmental Incident Reporting page
status_reason: Utility page of spill notices (search only).

status_reason: Posts and archives FL PNP and GA spill reports for the Suwannee basin.
